title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Stanford CS336 Course: Stanford's "Language Modeling from Scratch" (CS336) course is highly recommended for building full-stack LLM understanding, covering architecture, training, and deployment.
Agent-Reach Tool: A new open-source project named Agent-Reach simplifies web scraping across 14 platforms for AI agents without API keys.
Apple's Cost Surges: Tim Cook reported that Apple is facing unprecedented price hikes across operations, a trend Elon Musk noted as the largest cost jump he has witnessed.
Football Transfer Updates: Real Madrid is activating its €9m buy-back clause for Nico Páz from Como, while Bayern Munich finalized a €55m deal for Nathaniel Brown.
Raphinha's Financial Dispute: Barcelona's Raphinha discovered significant career funds were withheld by his father, who kept 80% of his rights and earnings.

items.title: @0xLinehigher: Stanford CS336 Recommendation
